The previous question on the motion to recommit was ordered pursuant to clause 2(b) of rule XIX.
Mr. Cisneros moved to recommit to the Committee on Small Business. (text: CR H2488)
The previous question was ordered pursuant to the rule.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with one hour of debate on H.R. 2931.

items.purpose: Pursuant to the provisions of H. Res. 458, the amendment in the nature of a substitute recommended by the Committee on Small Business now printed in the bill, modified by the amendment printed in part B of House Report 119-130 is considered as adopted.

dimensions.assessment: Affects SBA regional, district, and local office personnel, office heads, and small businesses interacting with affected regional offices.
dimensions.evidence: each employee of the Administration whose duty station was at such covered office shall be assigned to a duty station at another covered office

dimensions.assessment: Major organizational disruption for affected agency offices, including mandatory office relocation, potential cessation of operations, and removal of office heads.
dimensions.evidence: the Administrator shall immediately remove the head of a covered office required to submit a written explanation

dimensions.assessment: Involves relocation and administrative costs for moving federal agency offices, though exact dollar figures are not specified.
Creates a broad new restriction prohibiting SBA offices in sanctuary jurisdictions and imposing mandatory relocation and closure penalties.
dimensions.evidence: The Administrator may not establish a covered office in sanctuary jurisdiction.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory prohibition on establishing or maintaining offices in sanctuary jurisdictions, with specific 120-day relocation deadlines.
dimensions.evidence: Not later 120 days after the Administrator makes publicly available a determination... the Administrator shall relocate

missing_information: Specific estimates of the financial costs required to relocate the affected SBA offices.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the relocation of Small Business Administration regional, district, or local offices located in jurisdictions defined as sanctuary jurisdictions within 120 days, and enforces operational cessation and employee reassignment for noncompliance.

related.title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2483) to reauthorize certain programs that provide for opioid use disorder prevention, treatment, and recovery, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2931) to direct the Administrator of the Small Business Administration to relocate certain offices of the Small Business Administration in sanctuary jurisdictions, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2966) to require the Administrator of the Small Business Administration to require an applicant for certain loans of the Administration to provide certain citizenship status documentation, and for other purposes; and providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2987) to amend the Small Business Act to require a limit on the number of small business lending companies, and for other purposes.
